kind: independent bounded recenter contract CPU regression
method: Real public recenter/reobserve and internal _plan control flow exercised. _state_context, _mouth, _section_envelopes, _evaluate_offset and planner outputs replaced in-process with explicit synthetic fixtures to isolate contracts. Arbitrary full quaternion used; no dynamics or robot reachability inferred.

limitations: Synthetic contract tests do not establish collision clearance, soft shape fit, contact feasibility, grasp retention or successful insertion.
Mock state context retains finite observation time validation but bypasses real mesh/physical gates, which are outside this interface regression.
